about: The public layer (mods.md §10.1): each skin sets its hooks on <html>, and the rules that used to name the skin apply through the hook. One Max picture per skin with the Fancy scrubber on; the probe reads the hooks and one style only the hooked rule sets.
pass: Six shots, no EXPECT FAIL; each picture shows that skin's own scrubber and canvas.

steps.probe: (() => { const r = document.documentElement, h = document.querySelector('.scrub__handle'), cs = h && getComputedStyle(h), tb = document.querySelector('.titlebar'); return JSON.stringify({ skin: r.dataset.skin, scrub: r.dataset.hookScrub || '', material: r.dataset.hookMaterial || '', sea: r.dataset.hookSea || '', record: r.dataset.hookRecord || '', wallpaper: r.dataset.hookWallpaper || '', handleW: cs ? cs.width : null, handleMask: cs ? (cs.maskImage === 'none' ? 'none' : 'image') : null, titlebarSeam: tb ? getComputedStyle(tb).boxShadow !== 'none' : null }); })()
